whenToUse: Requests that are usually fast but sometimes slow.
A spinner flashing on and off is distracting.
Frequently repeated loading, such as switching filters or tabs.
whenNotToUse: Tasks that always take long (show progress from the start).
Places where no immediate reaction makes people press again (change the button state right away).
Lists whose layout should be reserved in advance (use a skeleton).

alternatives.name: Spinner
alternatives.reason: The wait is always long enough to notice.

alternatives.name: Skeleton
alternatives.reason: Showing the space for incoming content first.

accessibility: The spinner is read only when it appears, with role="status" and a "Loading" message.
Short requests announce nothing, so screen reader users don't hear needless messages either.
A minimum display time prevents a rapidly flickering screen.
The rotation stops with reduced motion.
